say:1:1660009001:0.text: One by one, the villagers start showing up, each hoping you can make things right...
say:1:1660009001:0.source_cn: 把你们当作依靠的村民们陆续前来请求帮助……
say:1:1660009001:0.male: One by one, the villagers start showing up, each hoping you can make things right...
say:1:1660009001:0.female: One by one, the villagers start showing up, each hoping you can make things right...

say:3:1660009002:1.text: When the Hypofiends attacked, I lost my ring... it was a gift from my husband before he left on his last journey...
say:3:1660009002:1.source_cn: 刚刚魔物来袭的时候，我的戒指丢失了，那是我丈夫远行之前...

say:4:1660009003:0.text: So you want us to help find the ring? Alright, we're on it.
say:4:1660009003:0.source_cn: 是想让我们帮忙找戒指对吧？明白了，这个委托我们接下了。

say:7:1660009004:1.text: After a bit of searching, you spot a ring tucked away in the corner of the warehouse. It's just that...
say:7:1660009004:1.source_cn: 经过一番搜寻，你们终于在村庄仓库的角落发现了那枚戒指，...
say:7:1660009004:1.male: After a bit of searching, you spot a ring tucked away in the corner of the warehouse. It's just that...
say:7:1660009004:1.female: After a bit of searching, you spot a ring tucked away in the corner of the warehouse. It's just that...

say:9:1660009005:0.text: Finally found it. But it's wedged in so deep there's no way to pull it out by hand.
say:9:1660009005:0.source_cn: 总算找到了，但这戒指卡得可真深啊。手够不到，真难办。

say:10:1660009006:0.text: Want to try that "Gentle Breeze" spell from that book?
say:10:1660009006:0.source_cn: 要不要试试魔导书里那个“微风吹拂”魔法？

say:12:1660009007:0.text: As Frieren speaks, she raises her staff. A current of air begins to gather at the tip.
say:12:1660009007:0.source_cn: 芙莉莲说着举起了法杖，一股气流在法杖的杖尖汇聚起来。

say:13:1660009008:0.text: Wait a second, Frieren. If the wind is even slightly off, we might end up blowing the ring even farther out of reach.
say:13:1660009008:0.source_cn: 等等，芙莉莲。用风的话，如果力道和方向不对，可能会把戒...

say:14:1660009009:0.text: ... Then I'll need you to keep an eye on it for me.

say:15:1660009010:0.text: Got it. I'll guide you. Alright, Frieren, target's straight ahead, about one o'clock. Ease up on the power, just a bit!
say:15:1660009010:0.source_cn: 交给我吧，我来帮你校准。好了，芙莉莲，目标正前方，一点...

say:19:1660009012:0.text: A powerful gust bursts from the staff. Dust fills the air, debris skitters across the floor, and for a moment, it feels like the roof itself might tear loose.
say:19:1660009012:0.source_cn: 一股强劲的气流呼啸而过，一瞬间飞沙走石，连仓库的顶棚都...

choice_prompt:20:1660009013.text: Magic in this world really is touchy... Alright, let me tone it down a bit.
choice_prompt:20:1660009013.source_cn: 这个世界的魔法，调整起来有点难啊……我再减弱点威力试试。

say:22:1660009013:0.text: Magic in this world really is touchy... Alright, let me tone it down a bit.
say:22:1660009013:0.source_cn: 这个世界的魔法，调整起来有点难啊……我再减弱点威力试试。

say:23:1660009014:0.text: The ring rolled left with that last gust. Frieren, try aiming toward ten o'clock this time, and make the wind softer.
say:23:1660009014:0.source_cn: 戒指被刚才的风吹得往左滚了。芙莉莲，这回对着十点钟方向...

say:25:1660009016:0.text: There's the faintest tremor in the air. You barely feel it, but a loose strand of your hair lifts slightly on its own.
say:25:1660009016:0.source_cn: 空气中传来一丝极细微的扰动，你甚至没感觉到风，只看到自...
say:25:1660009016:0.male: There's the faintest tremor in the air. You barely feel it, but a loose strand of your hair lifts slightly on its own.
say:25:1660009016:0.female: There's the faintest tremor in the air. You barely feel it, but a loose strand of your hair lifts slightly on its own.

say:26:1660009017:0.text: That one was too soft. Frieren, boost the wind a bit and aim for the ground just under the ring!
say:26:1660009017:0.source_cn: 这次风又太小了。芙莉莲，风力稍微加强一点，对准戒指下方...

say:27:1660009018:0.source_cn: 戒指下方的地面……是这样吧。

say:28:1660009019:0.text: Yes, yes, just like that! It's moving! It's lifting! Keep going!
say:28:1660009019:0.source_cn: 对对对！就是这个力道！它动了！它被吹起来了！继续保持！

say:30:1660009020:0.text: This time, the wind gathers into a gentle yet focused stream. It cradles the ring perfectly, lifting it from the crack and guiding it upward through the air.
say:30:1660009020:0.source_cn: 这一次，一股恰到好处的气流从芙莉莲的法杖杖尖汇聚成形，...

say:32:1660009021:0.text: As Frieren lowers her staff, the wind subsides. The little ring drops with a soft ping, landing squarely in Himmel's palm.
say:32:1660009021:0.source_cn: 伴随着芙莉莲放下法杖的动作，气流散去，那枚小小的戒指“...

say:33:1660009022:0.text: Yes! That's what I call good teamwork!

choice_prompt:35:1660009026.text: Master Himmel! Please, allow me the honor of painting your portrait! Think of it as my thanks for helping carry my gear through the snow!
choice_prompt:35:1660009026.source_cn: 解决完暴雪造成的各种麻烦后，找到辛美尔时，他正和一位画家交谈着。

say:38:1660009024:0.text: The woman who lost her ring thanks you profusely. But with more people asking for help, you and Himmel decide to split up.
say:38:1660009024:0.source_cn: 戒指的失主对你们十分感激。眼看求助的人越来越多，你们决...
say:38:1660009024:0.male: The woman who lost her ring thanks you profusely. But with more people asking for help, you and Himmel decide to split up.
say:38:1660009024:0.female: The woman who lost her ring thanks you profusely. But with more people asking for help, you and Himmel decide to split up.

say:41:1660009025:0.text: Once you've dealt with the aftermath of the snowstorm, you find Himmel chatting with a painter.
say:41:1660009025:0.source_cn: 解决完暴雪造成的各种麻烦后，找到辛美尔时，他正和一位画...

say:43:1660009026:0.text: Master Himmel! Please, allow me the honor of painting your portrait! Think of it as my thanks for helping carry my gear through the snow!
say:43:1660009026:0.source_cn: 辛美尔大人！请务必让我为您作画留念！就当是您帮我搬运画...

say:44:1660009027:0.text: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to preserve this heroic profile for posterity...
say:44:1660009027:0.source_cn: 把我这副帅气的风姿画下来，流传后世也不错啊……

choice_prompt:47:1660009035.text: Excuse me, do you have any herbs that can help heal wounds?
choice_prompt:47:1660009035.source_cn: 奥克萨娜默默转身，又走向了另一边的草药店。你们决定跟在后面。

say:48:1660009029:0.text: Right. If we want to end this storm, we'll have to get through to Kiran. But that flower... it might be the only thing keeping him going. I just can't bring myself to take it away.
say:48:1660009029:0.source_cn: 是啊……要想阻止暴风雪，就必须说服基里尔……但那朵花，...

say:50:1660009030:0.text: Just then, a familiar figure shows up at a stall across the road. It's Oxana.
say:50:1660009030:0.source_cn: 就在此时，一个熟悉的身影出现在不远处的杂货摊前。是奥克萨娜。

say:52:1660009031:0.text: Excuse me, I'm looking for some buttons to match this old dress...
say:52:1660009031:0.source_cn: 您好，我想给这件衣服配几颗扣子……

say:53:1660009032:0.text: Buttons, you say? Let me see if I've got anything that matches...

say:55:1660009033:0.text: Wait. It's you! I don't have what you need. Go! Be on your way!
say:55:1660009033:0.source_cn: 啊……是你！我这里没有！你快走吧！

say:57:1660009034:0.text: Without a word, Oxana turns away and walks toward the herb shop across the street. You decide to follow.
say:57:1660009034:0.source_cn: 奥克萨娜默默转身，又走向了另一边的草药店。你们决定跟在后面。
say:57:1660009034:0.male: Without a word, Oxana turns away and walks toward the herb shop across the street. You decide to follow.
say:57:1660009034:0.female: Without a word, Oxana turns away and walks toward the herb shop across the street. You decide to follow.

say:59:1660009035:0.text: Excuse me, do you have any herbs that can help heal wounds?
say:59:1660009035:0.source_cn: 请问有能治愈伤口的草药吗？

say:60:1660009036:0.text: Sure. What kind of wound are we talking about?
say:60:1660009036:0.source_cn: 有啊，您要治什么样的伤？

say:61:1660009037:0.text: A slash wound. But... it's on a Graveborn.
say:61:1660009037:0.source_cn: 一种割伤。不过……是亡灵身上的伤口。

say:63:1660009038:0.text: Are you crazy? We don't deal with that kind of thing! Get out before you bring a curse down on us!
say:63:1660009038:0.source_cn: 你疯了？我们这不卖那种东西！快走！别把晦气带进来！

say:65:1660009039:0.text: Watching Oxana walk away with her head low, Himmel calls out to her.
say:65:1660009039:0.source_cn: 看着奥克萨娜失落的背影，辛美尔叫住了她。

say:67:1660009040:0.text: Oxana. Let us handle it. Tell us what you need, and we'll get it for you.
say:67:1660009040:0.source_cn: 奥克萨娜，我们替你去买你需要的东西吧。

say:68:1660009041:0.text: Thank you... I was only trying to find some buttons for this dress. I bought it right here, many years ago.
say:68:1660009041:0.source_cn: 啊……谢谢你。我只是想给这件旧衣服配上丢失的扣子。很多...

say:69:1660009042:0.text: This used to be my village. I haven't been back in so long. If you don't mind an old woman rambling... would you all take a walk with me?
say:69:1660009042:0.source_cn: 这里是我以前住的村子，很久没回来了。如果不嫌我这个老人...

choice:47:0:1.text: We need to deal with this storm first!
choice:47:0:1.source_cn: 作画可以，可眼下得先想办法阻止暴风雪
choice:47:0:1.male: We need to deal with this storm first!
choice:47:0:1.female: We need to deal with this storm first!

choice:35:0:1.text: Wait, why is everyone gathering around us?
choice:35:0:1.source_cn: 诶，怎么围过来的人越来越多了？<key:dialog2>
choice:35:0:1.male: Wait, why is everyone gathering around us?
choice:35:0:1.female: Wait, why is everyone gathering around us?

choice:20:1:2.text: The wind is still a bit too strong...
choice:20:1:2.male: The wind is still a bit too strong...
choice:20:1:2.female: The wind is still a bit too strong...
